subtopic: Buying and Redeeming Mutual Fund Shares
source_evidence: The purchase price is the next calculated NAV, plus any fees charged at the time of purchase. Mutual fund shares are redeemable. This means investors can sell the shares back to the fund at any time at the next calculated NAV, minus any fees charged at the time of redemption.
question: How are mutual fund shares bought and redeemed, and how is the price determined?
answer: Investors buy shares from the fund itself or through a broker or investment adviser. The purchase price is the next calculated NAV plus any purchase fees. Investors can redeem shares by selling them back to the fund, with the price based on the next calculated NAV minus any redemption fees.
